flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code to review/add/delete notices in a court application batch. Only unused UI data types/stubs; the court-process/process-cpc endpoint is called by ocmsadminui NoticeUPL useEndorsement but has no controller in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi.
note: The story asks the CPO to review the batch notice list, add/delete notices, amend editable fields, after which OCMS displays the reviewed list plus a summary. There is no screen, endpoint or service for add/delete of notices in a court application batch. One thing to watch: useEndorsement.tsx calls the court-process/process-cpc endpoint when the stage becomes CPC (useEndorsement.tsx:220-226), but grep for 'process-cpc' / 'court-process' in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi and thirdpartyapi finds no controller that receives it, so that call has no server side in this repo (and it is the UPL endorsement flow, not batch review). No relevant maintenance ticket. Cannot verify from repo: the endpoint may be in another service.
recommendation: Do not claim as completed based on this repo. Confirm with URA/the team where the batch review code lives; also check the server side of court-process/process-cpc.

steps.step: CPO sees the list of notices in the selected batch
steps.detail: No code: grep for court application / court batch / courtBatch / csd_batch / CourtApplication / process-cpc in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi and thirdpartyapi finds no controller, service or UI page to select or review a court application batch. The per-csd_batch_no search function is never called and the Court Application History tab is commented out (History.tsx:170-172).

steps.step: CPO adds a notice to the batch list
steps.detail: No write endpoint exists for a court application batch; the court case entity has no batch column.

steps.step: CPO deletes a notice from the batch list
steps.detail: No endpoint or service removes a notice from a batch (see also OCMS22.16).

steps.step: CPO amends the editable fields (court number, division, mention date/time)
steps.detail: Only a data type in the UI; there is no edit form and no save endpoint in the API.

steps.step: OCMS displays the reviewed notice list and a count summary
steps.detail: No summary screen. The court-process/process-cpc call in useEndorsement.tsx:220-226 has no controller in the repo (UPL flow, not batch review).
